basis: Brazil audit updated after FP2. Visually reviewed FIA Document 15 page 1: the Stewards impose a five-place drop for George Russell's sixth ICE, to be served at his next race, distinguishing the sanction from Technical Delegate Document 14. Document 16 page 1 records Franco Colapinto at 80.6 km/h against the event's 80 km/h pit-lane limit and fines the BWT Alpine F1 Team EUR 100. Document 18 pages 2-3 lists 13 deleted lap-time entries for ten named drivers at turns 1, 7, 10 and 12; these deletions are not a revised finishing classification. Document 19 page 2 orders deletion of the shown FP1 lap times for Franco Colapinto, Alexander Albon, Luke Browning, Rafael Camara and Dino Beganovic after their cars passed through a double-waved-yellow sector; the listed 2:05.129, 1:32.736, 1:33.848, 1:18.760 and OUT LAP entries are lap-time deletions, not a race penalty or revised FP1 classification. Visually checked FIA Document 17 page 2 against the official Formula1.com Practice 1 classification: all 22 entrants and the top three (Norris 1:11.717, Antonelli +0.082s, Verstappen +0.236s) agree. Visually checked new Document 22 page 2 against the official Formula1.com Practice 2 table: the 21 listed timed entrants match, led by Antonelli 1:10.763, Norris +0.253s, Verstappen +0.259s, Russell +0.273s and Piastri +0.321s. Hülkenberg has no timed entry; Formula1.com's report says he did not run. Documents 20 and 21 were visually reviewed: they summon Rafael Camara (Car 51) and Charles Leclerc (Car 16) and their team representatives at 17:40 BRT over an alleged Car 51 impeding Car 16 at Turn 15 at 16:31. The FIA listing last checked at 20:49 UTC contains no later ruling; do not infer a hearing outcome. Visually reviewed Document 23 pages 2-3: it lists ten FP2 lap entries for nine drivers (Albon appears twice) after track-use issues at Turns 1 and 4 and orders the listed lap times deleted, not a race penalty or a revised classification. Visually reviewed Document 24 page 1: it requires staying below 1:13.0 between the Safety Car lines during and after Qualifying and on reconnaissance laps while pit exit is open for the Race. Document 13 entry list page 2 confirms 22 race entrants and six additional FP1 stand-ins. Document 10 records a Mercedes curfew exception with no action; Document 9 records timely self-scrutineering submissions and Câmara's cockpit exit/driver-knee clearance. Existing reviews of Documents 8, 12 and 14 remain in force; Document 12's McLaren four-item declaration and ten nil returns, including its page-3 component diagram, were previously reviewed. Upgrade aims are not measured gains.
